newsitem.title: FINLAND: OPSTOCK SEES FINNISH LISTED FIRMS' EARNINGS RISING.
newsitem.headline: OPSTOCK SEES FINNISH LISTED FIRMS' EARNINGS RISING.

text.p: The net profit of companies listed on the Helsinki bourse will rise to 23.4 billion markka this year and to 29.5 billion in 1998 from 19.9 billion last year and 22.5 billion in 1995, brokerage Opstock said on Friday.
"All sectors -- except insurance where investment income will not rise to last year's level -- will improve their earnings this year," Opstock said in a statement.

The Finnish economic outlook and corporate result prospects were favourable and share prices should not fall due to domestic factors. But U.S. and European interest rate jitters would keep end-year 1997 returns on stocks to 8-10 percent, Opstock said.
